correctness.rationale: Uniform convergence follows from s>1 and positivity from Schoenberg. The phase of the interior Legendre expansion at 4j+1 converts the equatorial difference into a sine Dirichlet series with error O(h); the scaled series converges to a sine-Mellin integral with the correct Gamma(1-alpha)sin(pi alpha/2)/alpha coefficient. Faster-decaying tails produce o(h^alpha). Direct recurrence checks confirm signs and normalization without being used as proof.
